summary: Purchase 50 SCA licenses + SCIM/SSO onboarding for Platform Security team's code-risk program
description: Issue summary: Platform Security needs to procure a short‑list SCA (Software Composition Analysis) vendor and purchase 50 user seats for org-wide code scanning by end of Q1. Background: Security has run a 2-week pilot with SentinelScan (trial instance) against core services and saw ~300 medium/low findings relevant to dependency hygiene. Request: finalize vendor evaluation (SentinelScan vs. OakAudit), obtain formal quote for 50 seats with SCIM + SSO (Okta) provisioning, and complete contract signature + license assignment. Must align billing to FIN-OPS budget code and ensure contract contains standard DPA + SOC2 language. Critical path items: vendor quote, SSO/SCIM test environment, procurement PO, and license activation.
requirements: 50 named seats with role-based admin/reader roles
SCIM support for automatic user provisioning (Okta)
SAML SSO configuration + test user setup
Support for private repo scanning (allowlist for internal mirrors)
Exportable findings CSV and API access for integration with alerting pipeline
timeline: 2026-03-01: ticket opened and pilot artifacts attached
2026-03-15: trial expiry and final PO submission
acceptance_criteria: 50 seats provisioned and visible in admin console
SCIM sync completes for a sample group (platform-security)
SAML SSO validated with 2 test users
Signed contract with DPA and SOC2 clauses attached to ticket
Integration test: findings exported and imported into security-alerts pipeline
comments: 2026-03-01 - Sofia Martinez: Attached pilot report (sentinel_pilot_2026-02.zip). Security recommends SentinelScan based on PR triage signal quality. Requesting procurement help to get quote and PO.

2026-03-02 - Evan Chen (Procurement): Reached out to SentinelScan and OakAudit for formal quotes; asked for enterprise pricing for 50 seats and SCIM/SSO setup costs. Asked Legal to pre-screen T&Cs for DPAs.
2026-03-03 - Priya Rao (Security): Confirming we need private repo scanning support and API keys for findings export. Also request a service-level commitment on scan latency for on-demand scans.
2026-03-04 - Finance (J. Alvarez): Please confirm the budget code and whether this is annual or monthly billing. Also request vendor W-9 and preferred invoice contact.

2026-03-05 - Evan Chen: Received preliminary quote from SentinelScan (50 seats, annual, $24,000) and OakAudit (50 seats, annual, $19,500 with 30-day onboarding fee). Sent to Legal for standard DPA review. Next: schedule SCIM/Okta test with IT SSO on 2026-03-09.
investigation_notes: Pilot findings: approx 300 findings classified as medium/low; SentinelScan deduplicates transitive dependency alerts better than OakAudit in our sample repos.
Onboarding complexity: SentinelScan supports SCIM groups but requires a connector for private Git mirrors; OakAudit supports private mirrors natively but charges onboarding fee.
Risk: If vendor contract delays past trial_end_date we may lose historical pilot artifacts; request grace period in contract or extension.
next_steps: Procurement to confirm final vendor selection by 2026-03-10
Legal to complete DPA review and confirm acceptable clauses
Schedule SCIM/Okta integration test on 2026-03-09 with IT SSO
Finance to approve PO and payment terms after quote finalization
